scenes.text: The first decimal place is tenths, next is hundredths and next is thousandths.
In 0.929, which digit occupies the tenths place? The answer is 9. 0.929 has digit 9 in its tenths place.
A measurement on a football field is 0.211 m. Which digit is in the thousandths place? Pause the video and think.
A measurement on a football field is 0.211 m. Which digit is in the thousandths place? The answer is 1. 0.211 has digit 1 in its thousandths place.
